notes: This is a source-only platform parity audit; mobile flows and tests were not executed.
conditional denotes actual native exposure with asset/account/provider/device/feature gates or explicitly stated partial parity; reasons identify differences from desktop.
no means the control is explicitly unsupported or absent from the audited complete native screen family/composition, not merely a missing filename.

unknown is retained for desktop-equivalent account export selection, continuous Sync connection indicator, and account/token-prefilled Trade entry because source inspection did not establish equivalent behavior.
ETH and SOL staking are manageable; ADA and TRX staking are explicitly view-only. Read-only Tron resources/votes are available even though mutation actions are not.
Native dApp fee selection is explicitly unfinished in TxSimulationInner, despite native Trade and Earn having their own functional fee selectors.
Minimum-received and MEV information were verified in mobile trade-history details; this does not prove matching pre-sign placement or historical MEV execution guarantees.
Native instant-staking notice parity is limited to the implemented instant-unstake banner.

Exact staking amount parity was audited separately from the generic Stake entry: native supports fiat/crypto amounts and Max, while the desktop percentage shortcuts were not found in the complete native amount-input composition.
